changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23. Resolution 26-07-04R (adopted 7-0 on July 20, 2026, published July 23, 2026) bars Aberdeen zoning and building officials from issuing any permit or license for the construction, development, or operation of a data center within city limits; any pending application is held without review or action. The resolution took immediate effect as an emergency measure under SDCL Sec. 9-19-13 and automatically expires and is repealed on November 18, 2026, or on the effective date of a zoning-ordinance amendment (Aberdeen City Code Chapter 60 - Zoning) addressing data centers, whichever is first. As of September 22, 2026, the City Attorney was still briefing the council on the timeline for that follow-on zoning ordinance, which had not yet been adopted.
changes.after: Resolution 26-10-01R, adopted October 19, 2026, extended and modified the original moratorium; it states a July 1, 2027 sunset at 12:01 a.m. local time or the earlier effective date of a qualifying zoning ordinance. Later actions and present force as of November 5 have not been independently established.
